study_id: Verified de-identified key; not patient name, registration number or inferred folder order

clinical_input_columns.baseline_monthly_frequency: History-reported mean monthly total seizure frequency; no 28/30-day conversion
clinical_input_columns.mri_lesional_status: nonlesional or lesional, based on final preoperative clinical judgment
clinical_input_columns.responder_12m: 0=less than 50% reduction; 1=at least 50% reduction, using the frozen clinical adjudication

missing_values: Empty CSV cells are missing, not zero; unknown categories are not silently recoded
metadata_scanner_indicator: Explicit 0/1 device indicator with documented reference; used for association only
metadata_scanner: Two actual device labels as strings; used for same-center scanner holdout
metadata_etiology_group: unknown, structural, other_known; fixed grouping from the analysis plan
